text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days before her debut race, Kitasan 
Black finished ahead of Satono Diamond in 
a tandem training session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Satono Diamond felt an uneasy 
sense of doubt, wondering why she couldn't 
surge ahead from behind as she usually 
did...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Armed with confidence from her training, 
Kitasan Black stepped forward to face her 
debut race.
